history.administration_response: In the third quarter of 2024, the Mediation Support Unit of the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs began to publish, on a quarterly basis on its website, peacemaker.un.org, its updates on the recent activities of the Unit and the Standby Team of Senior Mediation Advisers. This practice ensures a consistent approach to reporting, providing all Member States and donors with equal access to non- confidential information about the activities of the Unit and the Standby Team in a publicly accessible format. The Administration requests the closure of this recommendation by the Board.
history.board_assessment: Given that the updates have been published quarterly, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
